值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解獨立模擬遊戲《DressMaker》如何顛覆傳統換裝玩法，在 Steam 獲得 98% 壓倒性好評並匹敵 3A 大作。
  • 解析遊戲如何高度還原量身、選布到踩縫紉機的手作流程，探討其引發玩家強烈共鳴的「療癒與血汗」雙重魅力。
  • 揭開遊戲爆紅背後由三人獨立團隊打造的溫馨故事，見證製作人為患病女友延續服裝設計夢想的深情初衷。

摘要

換裝遊戲新革命：從穿搭走向親手裁縫

作者指出，過去的換裝遊戲多半僅停留在挑選服飾與外觀搭配，但黑馬獨立遊戲《DressMaker》打破了這項常規，讓玩家親自體驗將布料轉化為華麗禮服的完整工藝。該作在 Steam 平台迅速斬獲 98% 的壓倒性好評，同上人數甚至突破 4 萬人並超越諸多 3A 級遊戲。其兼具自由度與極致細節的慢活模擬，不僅吸引女性玩家，也讓無數男性玩家沉迷於色彩搭配與裁縫世界之中。

真實手作工序與社群熱議的「血汗代工」反差

在遊戲中，玩家化身為專業裁縫師，需要進行量身、草圖設計、挑選布料、拼接車縫以及手動添加鈕扣與綴飾。雖然遊戲簡化了枯燥的技術門檻，但從天鵝絨到針織等多種布料材質，皆須依顧客需求量身定做。作者提到，這套無時間限制的療癒流程雖獲《鐵拳》製作人原田勝弘大力推薦，卻也引來玩家逗趣吐槽：原本以為自己是走在時尚前端的香奈兒，一坐上縫紉機卻像極了工業革命時期的倫敦血汗勞工，引發熱烈話題。

神人輩出的社群創作與無限創意突破

隨著玩家社群日益龐大，各路高手紛紛在社群平台分享驚人成果。有玩家耗費數小時將梵谷名作《星夜》與《神奈川沖浪裏》化為禮服，甚至有人透過逐片羽毛拼貼縫製出絕美的狐狸大衣，更有硬核玩家拿出賽車腳踏板充當縫紉機踏板。這種神級創意與普通新手作品形成了強烈對比，讓社群充斥著詼諧幽默的自嘲與對遊戲高度自由度的驚嘆。

為愛而生的動人起源：延續夢想的深情之作

作者進一步揭開該遊戲背後溫暖人心的開發故事。《DressMaker》實際上是由三人小團隊研發，靈感源自製作人 Jonathan 與其女友 Sabrina 的真實人生。Sabrina 原本是一名極具天賦的服裝設計師，卻不幸罹患罕見的埃勒斯-當洛二氏症候群（EDS），導致身體無法承受實際裁縫的勞損。為了替女友重燃無法親手製衣的遺憾，製作團隊將這份深情化為代碼，最終打造出這款撫慰人心且大獲成功的溫暖作品。

================================================

I believe many female gamers played. those classic dress-up games on. mini-game platforms back in their. childhood. With just a few clicks and. drags of the mouse, you could outfit. your character in a beautiful wardrobe. These games not only allowed players to. project their aesthetics and fashion. sense onto characters, but some even. sparked dreams of becoming fashion. designers. However, no one expected. that in 2026, a game would appear that. truly brings the player's tailoring. fantasies to life. Hi everyone, and. welcome to Player Confidential. In 2023. , Roblox's "Dress To Impress" became a. hit in the dress-up genre, thanks to. its highly flexible styling system and. competitive player-voting mechanic,. accumulating over 10 billion visits. Yet, no matter how fun these games are,. the core gameplay ultimately revolves. around picking clothes and styling; the. actual process of crafting a garment. from fabric is virtually non-existent. But not long ago, an indie game called. "DressMaker" unexpectedly exploded in. popularity, becoming the talk of the. gaming world and earning a 98% " Overwhelmingly Positive" rating simply. because it lets players experience the. process of turning a piece of fabric. into a gorgeous gown from scratch. Many. players call it a "time-sink"; once you. start playing, it's easy to lose track. of time, and some even claim this is. the game truly designed for women—. though, of course, "manly men" will. love it too. Let's be honest about the. biggest reasoning: It is designed for. women. >> However, there is actually a. heartwarming story behind the. development of this game. So, how did. this indie dark horse come out of. nowhere? Today, Player Confidential.

will share with you the hit story of. DressMaker, the game that lets you. become a tailor. If there’s anything. I’ve missed or anything you’d like. to add, feel free to leave a comment. below. Before we start the video,. remember to like and subscribe to our. channel, and don't forget to hit the. notification bell so you won't miss our. updates. Right to the point: Developed. by the South African indie studio. CozyLife and published by FFreLife,. DressMaker became an unexpected hit the. moment it launched. Besides garnering. overwhelming acclaim on Steam, the. game's concurrent player count has. maintained an average of around 30,000,. even peaking at over 40,000 at one. point. How insane is this achievement? It not only outperformed "Marathon," but it even stood toe-to-toe with AAA. titles like "Gears of War," with. DressMaker’s player count. occasionally even surpassing them. So,. what kind of magic does this seemingly. ordinary tailoring game have that. allows so many players to dive. headfirst into it? In DressMaker,. players take on the role of a tailor,. crafting a piece of clothing by hand. from start to finish. The entire. process is more than just choosing. outfits and styling; you must first. take the client's measurements, sketch. designs in your notebook, select. appropriate fabrics to cut, feed the. pieces into a sewing machine, and. finally, manually add various. embellishments and buttons. Players can. then sell these garments or fulfill. client commissions to earn an income. This process nearly recreates. real-world garment manufacturing,. though the game simplifies the tedious. parts to be more accessible, ensuring. that even players with no sewing.

experience can easily pick it up. The. truly charming part of the game is that. it isn't one of those simulations where. you just press a few buttons and the. system does everything for you; every. step, from design to production,. requires your hands-on participation,. and even fabrics are categorized into. cotton, knit, velvet, and other types. When dealing with different clients,. you must consider their specific. occasions and personal preferences; you. can listen attentively to their. requests to design something that meets. their expectations, or simply let your. creativity run wild to craft. one-of-a-kind pieces. Precisely because. of this, many players who never thought. they would be obsessed with a. dressmaking game find themselves unable. to stop once they start, with even male. players sitting at their computers,. seriously studying color palettes for. their outfits. There are no. anxiety-inducing time limits, and no. need to compete against other players. All that remains are the fabrics, the. sewing, and your own endless. imagination. This process of completing. work piece by piece at your own pace is. not only incredibly therapeutic, but. also fulfills many players 'childhood. dreams; even Tekken series producer. Katsuhiro Harada couldn't help but. highly recommend it, insisting this. game is a must-buy. Coupled with its. reasonable price, low system. requirements, and fresh theme, it. naturally sparked heated discussions in. the gaming community, with some even. joking that if your girlfriend loves to. play, this is a very convenient way to. keep her from bothering you while you. play your own games. However, don't. rush to assume this is a purely. therapeutic game you'll enjoy from.

start to finish, as many players soon. discover that while designing clothes. is joyful, actually starting the. construction is a different story. When. designing clothes, I feel like Coco. Chanel, a fashionista leading the. trends, but when it comes time to sew,. I feel like a laborer in an unknown. London garment factory during the. Industrial Revolution, toiling away at. the sewing machine to trade my sweat. and labor for a meager wage just to get. by. The brutally honest reviews caught. many players off guard, making them. laugh despite themselves, with some. even joking, "Another game that feels. like a second job after coming home. from work—the fashion design major. edition!" Interestingly, a paid. subscriber on Twitter posted that his. wife really wanted to play this game,. but because their budget was set aside. for home repairs, they had to wait. until next month to buy it. The guy was. immediately absolutely roasted by other. players, who felt he’d rather pay. Elon Musk for a subscription to X than. spend a little money on his wife. It. got so heated that many female players. offered to buy the game for her, while. others wished such a man would never. cross their path—it even reached the. point where the guy's wife had to film. a video to help him out. As the. Dressmaker player community grew more. active, players started sharing the. gorgeous gowns they created by hand on. various social media platforms. Only. then did players truly realize that. this casual tailoring game could be. played with such incredible,. over-the-top variety. One player spent. a full four hours incorporating the. classic Van Gogh masterpiece "Starry. Night" into a gown design, and even " The Great Wave off Kanagawa" was.

transformed into a piece of wearable. art. Beyond that, some recreated AKB48. costumes, others challenged themselves. to craft Hatsune Miku’s classic look,. and one master even painstakingly. placed buttons one by one to piece. together a lifelike koi fish. Of course. , since Dressmaker naturally attracts. many female players who love fashion. and design, the Sanrio family couldn't. be left out, with people managing to. recreate everything from cute. characters to girly designs in the game. . Even more extreme: what if the game. doesn't have a fur option? Then a true. artist insists on hand-crafting it; one. player took individual feathers and. pieced them together, eventually. forcing the creation of a stunningly. gorgeous fox dress. This near-maniacal. dedication to craftsmanship left many. players humbled, because while you’re. still trying to figure out how to make. a dress look decent, others are already. challenging themselves with high art in. the game. The works created by these. masters look like they belong in an. entirely different game, making many. casual players just want to give up. As. a result, the community is full of. self-deprecating jokes from players,. like, "Before I saw your work, I. realized I was basically just playing. around." Everyone is making high art in. this game, reaching levels I could. never attain in my lifetime, so forget. it—I'm just going to make a potato. sack dress. "We are definitely not. playing the same game, lol!" It's. hilarious to think that this dress. might have cost two quadrillion dollars. to make, yet the game only gives you. 100 bucks as a reward. My apologies, I. didn't realize I was playing the same. game as a pro. Some players are even. more abstract, using racing game pedals.

as sewing machine pedals, leaving the. community completely stunned. The. creative gowns made by players have. shown others the game's potential and. the players' own imagination. However,. with the game's sudden popularity and. success, the reason for its creation. surfaced, and players realized there. was a heartwarming story behind the. studio. Dressmaker was actually created. by Clive, a small team under Free Lives. . The core development team consists of. only three people: programmer and. designer R, artist Sera, and producer. Jonathan. The inspiration for this game. didn't come from market research, nor. was it a random decision to make a. dress-up game; it originated from the. lives of Jonathan and his girlfriend,. Sabrina—not that Sabrina the Teenage. Witch, though. I'm terrified. >> Sabrina is an experienced fashion. designer with real sewing skills and a. deep interest in fashion history. She. learned to sew from her mother as a. child and even wore a dress she made. herself on her first date with Jonathan. . She originally intended to pursue a. career in fashion design, but was later. diagnosed with Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome (. EDS), a rare condition affecting. connective tissue that severely. impacted her ability to continue sewing. . For someone who loved sewing from a. young age and dreamed of a career in. fashion design, this was undoubtedly a. formidable obstacle. So, in order to. help Sabrina reconnect with her passion. for sewing and design, Jonathan. suggested they turn the sewing process. into a game. The two created a simple. prototype, and later Jonathan brought. the concept to Free Lives, where the. team built a playable itch.io version. in just three weeks. When it first. launched, the studio couldn't get.

publisher Free Lives to support. development due to low download numbers. , but with player demand and downloads. surging, Free Lives finally officially. approved the development of the full. game. Dressmaker later achieved great. results with TikTok promotion; many. female players were excited to see they. could design their own clothes, and. Sabrina participated in all game design. decisions. As a consultant and quality. assessor, she gradually incorporated. the years of experience she had. accumulated into the game. As an indie. title, Dressmaker's success proves once. again that games don't need to. deliberately cater to a specific group,. or even everyone. What truly convinces. players to willingly spend their money. has never been flashy marketing or a. massive development budget, but rather. engaging content and the passion that. players can feel from the work. The. original purpose of this game was. actually quite simple: just a hope that. someone limited by illness could still. continue to enjoy what they love. No. one expected that a game born to. fulfill a small wish would unexpectedly. become a massive hit, not only. addicting countless players but also. helping many realize their childhood. dreams of becoming fashion designers. Perhaps this is the most charming. aspect of gaming. It doesn't have to. save the world, pursue hyper-realistic. graphics, or build a grand, expansive. worldview. Sometimes, a game just needs. to be fun and bring joy to its players. for it to have a purpose. So, what are. your thoughts on Dressmaker? Are you. also stuck in this "Hyperbolic Time. Chamber" unable to get out? Feel free. to share in the comments below! Join. our Patreon, where you can find some. truly excellent "gentlemanly" games.

摘要

更換主角引發反彈與取消實體片的預購風暴

作者指出，Sony PlayStation 在經歷連串政策挑戰後，其即將推出的新作《戰神：勞菲》（God of Laufey）再次掀起輿論狂潮。玩家社群對於替換靈魂主角克雷多斯的決定相當不滿，紛紛回憶起過往第一方作品強推女角的前例。加上官方取消實體光碟的方針，使得預購預告片釋出後迅速湧入近五成的不喜歡評價，玩家更憤怒嘲諷這是強迫預購「數位租借權」。

醒目的紫色調外觀與風格違和的果凍方塊夥伴

豪華版所贈送的外觀造型同樣招致批評，其採用的神秘紫色調被部分玩家聯想為近年所謂「覺醒遊戲」的過度標籤化象徵，甚至引發社群利用 AI 進行惡搞改圖。此外，遊戲中安排了由知名喜劇演員傑克·布萊克配音的神秘宇宙果凍方塊夥伴，其輕浮幽默的戰鬥互動與系列歷來沉重嚴肅的基調嚴重衝突，被眾多核心玩家批評格格不入且破壞氛圍。
